description: This Java class defines a REST controller for a Spring Boot application. It provides basic endpoints including a welcome message, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller that provides basic endpoints for a Spring Boot application, including welcome, documentation, health, and info endpoints.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message when the root URL is accessed.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects the request to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving the original scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a simple health status message indicating the application is running.
